senses.gloss: m. (ותק, cmp. Arab. vaṭiḳ, a. b. h. עָתֵק) enduring; trusty; strong; distinguished.—תלמיד ו׳ a faithful student, distinguished scholar.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:6">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:2:6">Cant. R. to VI, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 105a:2">Sabb. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>ו׳ נתתיך באומות</he> (omitted in Ms. M., a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 81">Yalk. Gen. 81</cite>) I made thee distinguished among the nations.—Pl. <he>וְתִיקִים</he>, <he>וְתִיקִין</he>.
Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ.—Esp. Vᵉthikin (Ancients), the conscientiously pious men of former days.
Ber. 9ᵇ ו׳ היו גומרין אותה עם וכ׳ (Tosef. ib. I, 2 מצותה עם וכ׳, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 60) the V. used to finish the reading of the Sh’mah &c.; ib. 25ᵇ; 26ᵃ; Y. ib. I, 3ᵃ bot. הוו׳.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 32b:14">R. Hash. 32ᵇ</cite>. [<he>וַתִּיקִין</he>, <cite ref="Gittin 70a:14">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00055"><he>וִיתֵּק</he></cite>.]
